name: society-mgmt-300k
description: Synthetic Node.js codebase (Society Management, ~300K LOC) used for backprop integration testing. Source is delivered as society_mgmt_300k.zip and extracted into src/ and tests/.

scripts.build: for f in $(find src -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; echo BUILD_OK
scripts.lint: for f in $(find src tests -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; echo LINT_OK
scripts.validate: npm run build && npm run test
